scope: Independent read-only review of the three duplicate-ID return branches, the complete new 14-case regression source, and the real AppState reward-drain/profile call chain.

exact_inverse.statement: Replacing only the three new _persist(current) blocks with their previous one-line returns reconstructs the freshly fetched exact28462 complete baseline.

findings: awardGameResult, awardQuizResult and the non-null-ID branch of awardLumoCardsResult validate their original input before the duplicate branch. A duplicate now awaits the existing _persist(current) and returns the same snapshot only after success.

No second credit, XP update, streak update, result-ID insertion or stream emission is performed by a duplicate. Normal non-duplicate _commit behavior, queue, load/fallback and generic reward caps are byte-identical.
The existing _persist fails on false and propagates exceptions. A newly loaded optimistic native snapshot can no longer clear a pending duplicate result merely because its ID is already present.

The 14 declared cases cover all three APIs waiting on an actual held platform write, each of false-after-memory, throw-after-memory and throw-after-commit through a fresh Dart cache/repository, and two real AppState-new-instance cases.

Tests preserve separate nativeMemory and durableDisk, generation tracking and whole-file commit semantics. They require an explicit positive retry, unchanged amounts and singleton result ID, no duplicate stream event, and a cold modeled disk reload after success.
The AppState tests deliberately avoid another profile-selection write after failure; otherwise that unrelated successful commit could flush the outstanding wallet and hide the missing-ACK defect.

SharedPreferences.resetStatic exists in the pinned2.5.5 source; test reset APIs and actual AppState captureLearningProfile/recordMemoryResult/hasPendingRewards/retryRewards signatures match the read source.
